rationale: For an educational parenting app focused on neurodivergent and hyperactive children, parents need a UI that feels calming, grounded, and reassuring. The user's mind map suggested mint/sage accents on a dark theme, but a Light Organic theme provides a much more therapeutic, accessible, and structured feel for reading dense articles. We are using a Warm Off-White/Sand base with Deep Sage Green and Mint accents to bridge the mind map's concept with optimal UX psychology.

cards.style: Neumorphic-lite or subtle outline. Background #FFFFFF, border 1px solid #E6E4DD, border-radius 16px, padding 20px.

buttons.primary: Background #5E8B7E, Text #FFFFFF, border-radius 999px, padding-vertical 16px, font WorkSans-Medium 16px, aligned center.
buttons.secondary: Background transparent, Border 2px solid #5E8B7E, Text #5E8B7E, border-radius 999px, padding-vertical 16px, aligned center.

inputs.style: Background #F0EFEA, border 1px solid transparent, border-radius 12px, padding 16px. On focus: border #5E8B7E.

bottom_navigation.style: Background #FFFFFF, top border 1px #E6E4DD, icon active tint #5E8B7E, inactive tint #A0ACA6, padding-bottom safe area.

dashboard.header: Welcome text with primary_font h2. Top right: user profile/avatar icon.
dashboard.hero_card: Contains 'hero_dashboard' image as background or side illustration. Text overlaid with high contrast. CTA to 'Continuă lectura' (Continue reading).
dashboard.categories_grid: Vertical list or bento grid. Each card uses respective category color from the palette, but faded (opacity 10-15%) for background, with the solid color for the icon/heading.

article_reader.layout: Large title (h1), 'Introducere' in body_large, 'Puncte Cheie' (Key Points) as bulleted list with custom sage green bullet icons, 'Sfaturi Practice' (Practical Tips) in a designated highlighted box (background #E0D4F5 or #F0EFEA).
article_reader.actions: Sticky bottom bar or Floating Action Button (FAB) for Bookmark and Mark as Read.

journal_tracker.layout: List of entries. Empty state uses 'journal_empty_state' image. FAB (+) to add a new log.
journal_tracker.form: Toggle buttons for behavior/meltdown severity, text area for notes, save button.

hero_dashboard.description: Abstract soft 3D organic clay shapes in sage green and warm sand. Use as the background for the daily tip/hero card on the dashboard.

journal_empty_state.description: Minimalist soft 3D illustration of a floating notebook. Use when the user has no journal or tracker entries yet.

category_icon_abstract.description: Soft 3D geometric shapes in muted terracotta and dusty blue. Use as a placeholder/abstract thumbnail for category cards or specific articles.

accessibility_and_testing.test_id_rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `testID` (for React Native) AND `data-testid` (if supporting web output) attribute. Use kebab-case, role-based naming (e.g., testID='login-submit-button').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text over colored backgrounds meets at least AA standard.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Build this in React Native / Expo. 2. Implement the 5 exact categories provided in the problem statement, natively in Romanian. 3. Use the provided category colors to distinguish the 5 topics visually. 4. Implement email/password auth flow. 5. Create a behaviour tracker/journaling feature for parents. 6. Integrate search across the educational content. 7. All UI copy must be in Romanian. 8. Strictly apply testID props to components.
